name: run_gh
description: Execute a GitHub CLI (gh) command. Use for interacting with GitHub repositories, pull requests, issues, workflows, and more.

command.description: The gh subcommand and arguments to execute (e.g., 'pr list --state open', 'issue create --title "Bug" --body "Details"')

repo.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (optional, defaults to current repo context)
